what_was_adopted: The preregistration is now in force. Candidate B -- the comparably-scaled distance, normalised by each partition's median nearest-cross-scene-neighbour distance -- is the declared next attempt at an identity criterion that survives a change of partition.
what_was_not_adopted: Candidate B is NOT adopted as the identity criterion. Adopting the declaration authorises the development evaluation on the four already-inspected blocks and nothing further. The reserved confirmatory blocks stay reserved until development evidence supports proceeding and a further amendment records that.
declaration_file_unchanged: The declaration is kept byte-identical and this adoption is recorded separately, so the artifact that was declared before measurement can still be verified against its own hash.
governing: R20: candidate B is evaluated alone. Evaluating it alongside C voids this.
Development results on the four inspected blocks are development evidence and may not be reported as confirmation.

development_outcome.summary: Normalising did not collapse the spread; it left it marginally wider.
development_outcome.why: The normaliser varies only 1.084x across blocks while the same-configuration scale varies 1.876x, sits 7-14x above that scale, and correlates -0.21 with it. A median over every configuration's nearest cross-scene neighbour is dominated by the unrelated majority -- 114 of 120 configurations per block are not the motif -- so it measures the nearest-UNRELATED distance, which is a different regime from the same-configuration one the radius operates in.
development_outcome.correction_to_this_declaration: The declaration stated that failure would show the shape was moving rather than the scale. That is NOT established and the reasoning was imprecise. The same-configuration scale still moves 1.876x; this particular label-free normaliser does not track it. Whether some other label-free normaliser would is open and would require its own declaration. The declaration file is left byte-identical and this correction is recorded here rather than edited into it.
development_outcome.what_this_does_not_authorise: It does not authorise trying variants until one works. A different normaliser is a new candidate needing its own declaration and adoption under R20. The reserved confirmatory blocks remain untouched and unreserved by this outcome.
